question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank no. 7.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Until**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Until **means up to the time or the event mentioned.
 
• **If **is used in sentences in which one thing only happens or is true when another thing happens or is true.
 
• **While **means at the same time as.
 
• **When **used for talking about the time at which something happens or happened.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning, "**Until**" is the most appropriate one to fill the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: **Till the spread of the poliovirus is stopped in these nations**

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *Polio was once a disease feared worldwide, striking suddenly and paralysing mainly children (1) for __life. WHO is a partner in the Global Polio Eradication Initiative, the __(2) largest__ private-public partnership for health, which has __(3) reduced__ polio by 99%. Polio now survives __(4) only __among the world's three poorest and __(5) most__ marginalised communities, where it stalks the most __(6) vulnerable__ children. These are - Afghanistan, Nigeria and Pakistan. **__(7)Until__** poliovirus transmission is interrupted in these countries, all (8)________ remain at risk of importation of polio, (9)________ vulnerable countries with weak public health and immunisation services. WHO's goal is (10)_______ every last child with polio vaccine and ensure a polio-free world for future generations.*
